Subject: Vendor onboarding - invoice format and delivery

Hi Hannah,

We're getting ready to set Redwood up as a vendor in our AP system. A couple quick questions so our team can process your invoices without delay: 

- Do you support e-invoicing (Peppol) or an electronic invoice XML schema?
- If not, can invoices be delivered to accounts-payable@greenbridge.co as PDF email attachments?
- Do you offer a billing portal/API we can push into our ERP instead?
- What fields do you need from us for vendor setup (GL mapping, VAT ID, remit-to)?

We also have PO PO-7782 in place for the first bill. And: is Net 45 an option on this engagement? Our standard is Net 45.

Appreciate a quick note so we can avoid payment delays.

Thanks,
Sara Lin
Finance Operations
GreenBridge Health
[Attachment: PO-7782.pdf]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <accounts-payable@greenbridge.co>
Cc: procurement@greenbridge.co, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-21T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - invoice format and delivery

Hi Sara — thanks for the details and the PO. Short answers below and a couple of suggested next steps: 

- E-invoicing: We can support Peppol for EU customers but that requires a short onboarding step and format validation. For US customers we currently offer portal delivery (automated PDF/XML exports) and direct email delivery of PDF invoices.
- Email delivery: yes — invoices can be sent to accounts-payable@greenbridge.co as PDF attachments; we can cc finance@greenbridge.co.
- Billing portal/API: we have a billing portal that can push invoice records to ERPs via SFTP or webhook. I can start portal onboarding; it usually takes 3 business days for the AP team to see the first export.
- Required fields: vendor name, remit address, VAT/Tax ID, preferred remittance (ACH/wire), and GL mapping if you want mapping on our side.

I attached a short vendor-setup-form for your AP team to fill out. If you'd like Peppol, we'll also send our partner's peppol-instructions PDF.

Regarding payment terms: our standard is Net 30. Net 45 is not default but we can escalate to Sales Ops for approval depending on contract banding. I want to loop in Dylan (cc'd) and Marissa from billing to give you a recommended path. 

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick confirmation from you on email vs portal vs Peppol.
2) If portal or Peppol, confirm the AP contact and share GL mapping (if needed).
3) We submit a request to Sales Ops for Net 45 and come back with an ETA.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor-setup-form.xlsx]
